inlines.v: CARMELIN, CARMELITE, adjective Belonging to the order of Carmelites. CARMELITE, noun [from Mount Carmel.] 1. A mendicant friar. The Carmelites have four tribes, and they have now thirty-eight provinces, besides the congregation in Mantua, in which are fifty-four monasteries, under a vicar general, and the congregations of barefooted Carmelites in Italy and Spain. They wear a scapulary, or small woolen habit, of a brown color, thrown over the shoulders. 2. A sort of pear.
